headline: Real product costs in the P&L and a production plan that stays fixed

items.title: Actual COGS in the D2C P&L
items.detail: Per-piece product cost from the manager's cost sheet replaces the flat 32% guess. Hard combos like the Diwali hamper are costed from their contents.

items.title: COGS from a Google Sheet
items.detail: The manager edits costs in the 'Cogs' sheet and the hourly run picks them up, with checks for typos and unknown SKUs. No code change per price update.

items.title: Demand dashboard follows the calendar month
items.detail: Seven planning cards now roll to the new month on the 1st and show plan units (forecast + safety stock) next to the forecast.

items.title: Meta spend survives campaign renames
items.detail: Renaming an ad campaign no longer moves its spend into the wrong category in the P&L.

items.title: Growth for Blinkit, Swiggy and Zepto
items.detail: Quick-commerce growth now uses a 30-day window (their PO data starts in August) and only ever raises the plan. December's quick-commerce forecast is up 3.7%.

items.title: Frozen 3-month plan card
items.detail: Raw material and production plan on the plan frozen on the 1st for the next 3 months, shown next to today's live forecast and how far it has moved.

items.title: P&L: Meta spend inside CM2
items.detail: The category P&L now counts Meta ad spend in CM2 together with freight, warehouse and payment costs. The separate CM3 lines are gone.

items.title: List of SKUs missing a cost
items.detail: Shared every SKU that has sales but no cost in the COGS sheet, so the manager could fill the gaps.

items.title: Plan vs Stock card
items.detail: Per SKU and warehouse: this month's remaining plan next to the stock on hand.

items.title: Demand projection by channel and warehouse
items.detail: Two dashboard cards now show the last 3 months, the current month and the next 3 months, like the other planning cards.

items.title: Diwali hamper cost estimate
items.detail: Costed the new 15-item Diwali combo from its parts (about Rs 515 before GST) and flagged the 3 parts that still need real costs.

items.title: Costing web app design for the COO
items.detail: Designed a BOM and product-costing web app with 6 roles (NPD, commercial, procurement, quality, admin) that writes straight to the database.

items.title: Budget tracker requirements
items.detail: Requirements and approach for a budget tracker: 8 teams log spend against Finance budgets, with Founder and Finance Head approval when over budget.

items.title: AWS Organizations guide
items.detail: Guide to running several AWS accounts under one bill with central access control, at no extra cost.

items.title: Architecture page refreshed
items.detail: The platform architecture page now shows all 24 live schedules, the B2B sources and the Google Sheets inputs.

upcoming.title: Costing web app, first version
upcoming.detail: BOM entry, cost per pack and margin views for the 6 roles, with an Excel upload for the first load.

upcoming.title: Demand dashboard: lost sales, forecast accuracy, KPI tiles
upcoming.detail: The next cards on the planning dashboard after Plan vs Stock.

upcoming.title: Diwali hamper into the COGS sync
upcoming.detail: The COGS sheet sync is on hold until the new combo is created in Unicommerce.

upcoming.detail: This page builds and goes live on every push, with one fixed link.
